description:
On 15 November 2023 we verified that Global Holdings Inc. (parent identifier GH‑00123), a corporation domiciled in Delaware, USA, directly controls Tech Innovations LLC (subsidiary identifier TI‑98765), which operates in California, USA. The ownership stake is 80 % of the subsidiary, and our assessment is marked with a HIGH confidence level. The relationship was first documented on 1 January 2020 and remained in effect at least until 31 December 2025.  

The data were retrieved on 10 June 2024 from the report available at https://example.com/report.pdf. All observations pertain to the sample date of 15 November 2023, and the details are recorded in accordance with our internal documentation standards.
